notes.Mahanadi Coalfields Limited: Bidding is open until 23 Nov and was 0.48x subscribed on day 2; QIBs are at 1.37x while retail is 0.24x. Institutions usually bid late, so early numbers say little. The issue is entirely offer-for-sale, so no money goes to the company. One lot costs about Rs 14,960; only a small bet is sensible, ideally after checking final-day demand.
notes.Watrana Rentals Limited: This SME issue was subscribed 11.1x overall, showing strong demand, though no category split is available. SME stocks have large lots, thin trading and big price swings. One lot costs about Rs 1.47 lakh, which is heavy for a small bet. Our score of 53 is below the bar to apply, so treat it as watch only.
notes.Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech Industries: Opens 25 Nov with no subscription data yet, so demand is unknown. It is an SME issue, entirely fresh capital, with thin trading and large swings. One lot costs about Rs 1.42 lakh, which is too large for a small bet. Wait for demand data before deciding.
